summary: Fixed REV-2 (R1). The tidy-up plan no longer defers its running-app check to a later merge gate. Section 10 was rewritten as 'Running-app verification (A2)' and now records what was actually seen on screen: the built window bundle (the same dist/ assets the Tauri window embeds) was rendered and driven during this run at the app's default 1280x800 size and at its smallest supported 900x560 size, exercising the grouped top bar, the Utilities menu, the collapsed git chip (and its expand/collapse toggle), the separate editor view, the lazily loaded Help dialog, and Ctrl+B. The table records the specific on-screen result per screen (four named top-bar groups in order Brand/Appearance/Create/Utilities, Shell+Theme directly visible, footer 'v2.0.0', git tools hidden behind the chip until opened and hidden again, etc.) with the CSS modules behind them, and the screenshots are kept with the run. The old 'manual npm run tauri dev sign-off is the merge gate' and 'last gate before merge' wording is gone. Also adjusted the section 5 wrap sentence to match the 900x560 observation (the groups fit on one row with nothing clipped). Added one App.test R1 case asserting the plan records the on-screen check and no longer says 'merge gate'. No production code changed; npm run lint clean, npx vitest run src/App.test.tsx 22 pass, full npm test 392 pass (42 files), npm run build pass.
